early.name: Melee Lifesteal
early.annotation: Activates on Bashdown. Heavy melee minion waves to keep the cooldown short. Feel free to sell this first.

early.name: Extra Regen
early.annotation: Very solid green item, always worth taking if you're taking more damage than you'd like.

early.name: Stalker
early.annotation: Not terrible but the bleed doesn't seem to have much of a purpose in mid-game still after its rework.

early.name: Battle Vest
early.annotation: Nice bullet resist and damage output increase.

mid.name: Bullet Resist Shredder
mid.annotation: Resist, shred, and gets you 4.8k spirit. Synergizes well with Torment Pulse.

mid.name: Spirit Snatch
mid.annotation: Still an insane item, arguably even better on Billy now once Bashdown reaches Lv3. Helps you reach bigger burst with Bashdown.

mid.name: Spirit Resilience
mid.annotation: Spirit damage feels pretty prevalent as a frontliner right now, so I personally take Spirit Resilience at some point in the game. Very strong effect that pairs well with more spirit resist or Frenzy.

mid.name: Rapid Recharge
mid.annotation: Good item allows for 1-2 extra bashdowns each fight. [You can replace Torment Pulse for this] This item becomes crazy good with cooldown aswell as it allows for melee charge and Snatch uptime with (1)

mid.name: Greater Expansion
mid.annotation: Synergizes with all your Bashdown and Chain Gang very well and also gives you spirit resist on top.

late.name: Crushing Fists
late.annotation: Only makes sense to invest in more utility since we have Melee Charge. The stun can be really useful for interrupting channels.

late.name: Colossus
late.annotation: Fat HP increase + insane resists and more weapon damage. Very good tank item. Now gives bonus melee damage when active, which is nice.

late.name: Phantom Strike
late.annotation: Kill flyers - remember you can also pull flyers down with your RAM + HOLD Bashdown

late.name: Frenzy
late.annotation: Buy if the enemy has lots of spirit damage.

late.name: Crippling Headshot
late.annotation: Super easy to activate shred for both damage types + antiheal. Super necessary into high resistance frontliners like Yamato, Abrams, Victor, etc.

late.name: Plated Armor
late.annotation: Very good item against really strong gun characters when you already have some bullet resist.

1548066885.annotation: More ammo to keep pressure with m1. Blasted ammo refill is scaled by max ammo, so this makes our light melee reload more effective.

2463960640.annotation: Great stat increases + bullet resist that scales pretty high and lasts a long time. Has no fall-off range so you can shoot targets from afar to get your resist stacks early.

3970837787.annotation: Very good spirit power (+ resist) increase item. Spirit power not only increases your damage but also your Blasted bonus HP scaling.

1009965641.annotation: Helps you kill all NPCs faster to gain wave prio and take jungle faster. Take less chip damage from all NPCs. Super good item.

3862866912.annotation: I've been going resto shot in lane first before Melee Lifesteal and it feels so good, sometimes go both for more sustain early. Its for 4.8k gun spike early [Can sell After Escalating Resil or for it]

395944548.annotation: A lot of DPS by being near people, usually bought in mid-game but I personally don't prioritize spirit damage as much on this character.

380806748.annotation: Ult bot. Cooldown on ult and can be upgraded if slot locked. [Can be Swapped for BRS] When upgraded it helps with ur lifestrike, Torment and Melee Charge cooldowns aswell.

2971868509.annotation: Resist, shred, and gets you 4.8k spirit. Synergizes well with Torment Pulse.

2064029594.annotation: For big chunky healthy people + 10 flat spirit | This + Point Blank for Spike [Skip Escalating] For faster gun spike

339443430.annotation: Very good item to resist incoming spirit damage and retaliate with bonus stats. In primarily spirit comps, pair with Spirit Resilience for 75% resist.

865846625.annotation: Infinite Healing and Sustain, u wanna shoot mostly and not use a lot of melees from this point. Use your 1 to reload.

3884003354.annotation: Super easy to activate shred for both damage types + antiheal. Super necessary into high resistance frontliners like Yamato, Abrams, Victor, etc.

112198670.annotation: Nerfed, but still good. Now not the answer to everything but still worth considering.

1252627263.annotation: Definitely way weaker, especially early on. Works well with Colossus. Much later provides nice relevant bursts.

1813726886.annotation: Better item now. Silences movement abilities, so it's very good for shutting down characters who rely on them like Lash, Mina, or Infernus.

1152158042.annotation: Insane CC item. Pairs really well with Bashdown and Chain Gang. With Vortex Web you dictate the teamfight.

1378931225.annotation: Immune to bullets for a bit

3696726732.annotation: Strong antiheal and percent health bleed. Gives no stat bonuses which kind of sucks but this item is still good.

1055679805.annotation: Less healing than Leech passively but when active component is used it heals you by over 1000. With Frenzy pop Vampiric Burst below 50% HP to maximize fire rate and healing.

2951612397.annotation: Put On Blasted for Longer Duration!

1282141666.annotation: Good sustain and taking %max hp. Great vs tanky units.

2037039379.annotation: Like Silencer, this item works with Bashdown, so you can affect multiple people at once. Gives a HUGE damage bonus and really good bonus health too. Destroy Abrams.

1113837674.annotation: Lowers enemy spirit damage output, and silences them. It builds up stacks on your Bashdown so you can hit multiple people with it at once. Very good.

3028234315.annotation: *clink* *clink* *clink* Vs Heavy spirit dps could be good for more cooldowns!

1932939246.annotation: Strong for ult usage and mid-boss fights. Bashdown and Rising Ram soft cc can be used to force people to stay in the fire.

1414319208.annotation: If you already have stacked bullet resist this can help you stack more and helps you build more weapon damage fast. Worth considering selling Cultist Sacrifice for this.

1710079648.annotation: Actually OP item. Use this inbetween waves and hit boxes, take sinners, or take camps. Can be bought later if you're omega pooping on the enemy lane (would still buy anyway though).

2829638276.annotation: Very solid green item, always worth taking if you're taking more damage than you'd like.

4204808176.annotation: For the naughty laners who like to melee you a lot. Don't just spam it like a bot, that will get you killed.

2717651715.annotation: This character NEEDS Blasted active to be OP right now. Superior makes our duration longer and scales the amount of time melees extend it. OP on upgraded Rising Ram too.v

3140772621.annotation: More useful now than pre-November patch. Fat resist bonus when low.

989206714.annotation: Gives spirit resist, fire rate, and FAT debuff resist. Definitely pick into hard CC.

1976391348.annotation: Gives spirit resist and is lowkey a little OP. Strong early damage that scales and slows for a long duration. Effectively a 5th ability. Do not sleep on this item.

1925087134.annotation: Very helpful when played into characters that rely on their m1.

1254091416.annotation: Like Slowing Hex, kind of OP, lets you get picks easier and shuts down people in the sky.

619484391.annotation: Fallen from grace since last patch but still a silence which proves useful when ambushing enemies.

2617435668.annotation: Another item to shutdown carries with, boasting even more debuffs and clearing all buffs.

2603935618.annotation: Cheap antiheal and heals on kill. Great for ganking playstyle.

3144988365.annotation: 50% heal reduction is pretty large and also bleeds 30% of someone's health for its duration. Gives bonus spirit power and health which are very nice.

2519598785.annotation: If you're really agead or don't have any particular item you need to buy scaling your Blasted even further is pretty big.

630839635.annotation: Mostly testing right now but being Blasted is more important than ever, so never not having Blasted is kind of big.

2356412290.annotation: Even more ammo and gun damage. Extra ammo is important because it scales our melee ammo replenish and lets us mix up our melee mindgames.

3294954488.annotation: This item is INSANE damage. Cultist Sacrifice is less necessary with how squishy jungle is now, and this grants you the range and damage aspect but better early on.

710436191.annotation: Higher DPS and hard movement lock on whoever you hit. Very easy to hit targets with the active component after Rising Ram or Bashdown. Useful for slippery targets.

1770441818.annotation: Cheap and easy bullet resist shred.

2481177645.annotation: Big bullet resist shred on alone targets, and bullet resist shred around people in general.
